content: Downloadable brochures are a standard corporate-site lead-capture pattern, but can be offered gated (form) or ungated (direct PDF link) depending on lead-gen priority. Effective brochures lead with a benefit-focused headline, structure content around who/what/why/how-to-contact, and end with a low-friction next step (e.g. WhatsApp/contact link) rather than a hard sales pitch.
